note: The storage conformance cases of docs/storage-conformance.md: scenarios for the candle, journal and segment ports, each step with what a conforming store returns, and the dirty-window races each backend steps through. Written by spikes/storage-contract/conformance_cases.py, not by the Rust code under test.
series_rule: candle i of a series, for i from 0 to count - 1 (only those in range [a, b) when a range is given, and none listed in skip): open_time_ms = from + i * spacing_ms (spacing_ms defaults to the market's interval step); close_time_ms = open_time_ms + step - 1; open, high, low and close are the close text when one is given, otherwise "{100 + i % 50}.{i % 100, two digits}"; volume is "0.50000000"; trades is open_time_ms modulo 97, never negative; candles are written in rising i

candles.doc: a market without candles reads nothing
an upsert counts the candles it was given, not the rows it added
a candle written again under its open time replaces every other column
of two candles with one open time in a batch, the later is kept
a load is ascending with both bounds included and keeps the oldest; recent keeps the newest, ascending
a range holding no candle, a zero limit and a reversed range read nothing
a bound on a candle's open time includes it, and one past it does not
the same open time on every product line, symbol and interval reads back only its own candle
every decimal column keeps the text it was written with, scale included

steps.sql: SELECT open, high, low, close, volume FROM candles WHERE exchange = 'binance_spot' AND symbol = 'BTCUSDT' AND interval = '1m' ORDER BY open_time_ms

candles.doc: an unknown trade count stays unknown and is not zero
every trade count from 0 to the largest unsigned 64-bit one reads back unchanged
a batch holding a candle no segment window can hold is refused whole
a store opened again on the same database resumes from its newest candle

journal.doc: a run reads back in full: position, cursor, error and configuration
a run never created reads nothing
a run is created once, and its first identity stays

refused.contains: only a migration marks runs legacy

journal.doc: a run is saved only after it was created
saving replaces the state and never the identity

steps.sql: SELECT environment, account_kind, account_id, identity_source, status FROM bot_runs WHERE run_id = 'run-1'
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT) FROM bot_runs

journal.doc: the latest run is the last updated of its market and strategy; another strategy, interval, venue or family never wins
of runs updated in the same millisecond the one started later is the latest, then the greater run ID
order events read back newest first, up to the limit, exactly as appended
an order event appended twice is listed twice
closed trades read back newest first with their scale and their missing order IDs
a store opened again on the same database loads a run for resume
columns hold the wire forms and the JSON the serde tokens

steps.sql: SELECT exchange, symbol, interval, strategy_name, status FROM bot_runs WHERE run_id = 'run-1'
SELECT state_json FROM bot_runs WHERE run_id = 'run-1'
SELECT symbol, side, order_type, status, order_id FROM order_events WHERE run_id = 'run-1'
SELECT raw_json FROM order_events WHERE run_id = 'run-1'

journal.doc: a legacy run loads with no environment and no account, is found as the latest, and is never driven

segments.doc: a market without candles is all tip
a refresh packs every closed window and leaves the tip
candles written in any order pack to the same segments
a second refresh, and an identical resync, change nothing
a window changed and changed back keeps its segment
the window of the newest candle stays in the tip until a later window starts
a backfill reopens its window at once, the next refresh packs only that window, and the segment it replaced still loads
a candle written again with another scale packs to a new segment
a plan lists the segments a range overlaps, oldest first, then the tip
three-day and weekly candles stay in the tip of their long windows
a window holding more candles than a segment keeps itself and every later window in the tip
stored text not in its exact form is left unpacked rather than corrected

steps.sql: UPDATE candles SET close = '0100.00' WHERE exchange = 'binance_spot' AND symbol = 'BTCUSDT' AND interval = '1m' AND open_time_ms = 1792454400000

segments.doc: a stored segment opens under its name to the candles it packs; an unknown name loads nothing
the same candles under two product lines share one segment, listed by two index entries

steps.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT) FROM segments WHERE hash = 'sha256:ed9522e11f902b8262101847f7afcac759eb7bda592fc217704989b52d11a1c8'
SELECT exchange FROM segment_index WHERE hash = 'sha256:ed9522e11f902b8262101847f7afcac759eb7bda592fc217704989b52d11a1c8' ORDER BY exchange

races.doc: a write between a refresh's read and its write-back keeps the window dirty, and the next refresh packs the new candles
of two refreshes packing one window, the later finds it done elsewhere
